description:
Maker 3D CAD - the middle ground between Tinkercad and FreeCAD.

Materializr is open-source 3D CAD for makers - the middle ground between
dead-simple tools like Tinkercad and full professional suites like FreeCAD.
Sketch on a plane, pull it into a solid (extrude, revolve, loft, sweep),
fillet and chamfer, run booleans, cut threads, and edit any step of the
history later. Sketches export to SVG and DXF at 1:1 mm for laser cutters and
2.5D CNC; it imports STEP, IGES, BREP, STL, SVG and DXF, and exports STEP,
STL, IGES, BREP, glTF, OBJ, 3MF, SVG and DXF. Real B-rep solids on the
OpenCASCADE kernel.
Materializr 1.8.0
The first stable 1.8.0, after six betas.
New
- Simplified Chinese is now the seventh interface language
- Rearrange the tool rails by long-pressing a tool and dragging it
- The Home Screen lists your open projects and switches to one with a click
- Progress and Cancel for slow work: big body patterns, Booleans, switching to a heavy tab, Undo/Redo of a Boolean
- Help > Report a Bug sends a bug report, feature request or question straight to GitHub
Changed
- Windows opens only its own window: no black console beside the app
- Moving a sketch, or the body it builds, takes the sketches drawn on that body with it
- Extrude, Subtract and Push/Pull remember whether they were applied to a whole sketch or to picked contours
Fixed
- Rotating a selection in a sketch keeps its shape; dragging a corner of a rotated rectangle no longer tears it apart
- Copy, Multiply, patterns, Mirror and Offset handle every kind of curve
- Chamfer sizes that can't fit are refused with a message
- A perspective zoom-out no longer stalls beside a thin wall
Known issue
- A chamfer built on another chamfer can still lose its edges when the sketch under it is moved by certain distances; it is switched off with a message
Thanks
- Thanks to Iron47wd for testing and bug reports, and ROMHAM666 for the Simplified Chinese translation
